0.long_answer: The gene in question is SDHA, which encodes a 664-amino acid protein that is a major catalytic subunit of the mitochondrial respiratory chain complex II. Mutations in this gene have been associated with mitochondrial complex II deficiency. According to the provided data, the SDHA gene is located on the p arm of chromosome 5 at locus 15 and is composed of 17 exons.
